# Define the business model and unit economics

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before committing to a customer segment, product model or major operating change. An approved business-model brief with tested assumptions, contribution economics and the next validation decision.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Describe the customer and value exchange

agent-runnable


Write down who uses the product, who pays, the problem addressed, the delivery model and alternatives. Separate observed customer evidence from founder assumptions and link the evidence to each assumption.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Model contribution economics

agent-runnable


Build scenarios for price, acquisition cost, delivery cost, support load and retention using explicit units and time periods. Label unknowns and reconcile revenue assumptions with how billing and collections will work.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Choose a testable business-model hypothesis

human · human approval required


Review the scenarios with the responsible founders. Select the smallest commercial test, the cash exposure allowed and the evidence that would cause a change of direction.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Connect the hypothesis to the operating plan

agent-runnable


Turn the selected model into named customer, product, financing and hiring milestones. Record dependencies rather than treating projected revenue as money already available.

- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Review evidence and approve the next commitment

human · human approval required


Compare actual customer behavior and delivery costs with the agreed test. Record whether to continue, revise or stop, with the owner and evidence for the next review.

- Verify: An approved business-model brief with tested assumptions, contribution economics and the next validation decision.
- Sources: [SBA manage your business](https://www.sba.gov/counseling/manage-your-business/)
